verdict.rationale: Kimi Code (desktop and CLI) documents an agent that can read and edit files in a local folder, run commands and verify results. That is first-party code execution against the user's own files, but it is framed around development tasks rather than data analysis. The file-QA docs cover uploading files and answering questions by extracting their contents, not by running code. Missing for 10: documented data-analysis code execution in the assistant, chart/visualization generation, downloadable output files, sandboxed execution details, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files

citations.quote: let the Agent read code, edit files, run commands, and verify results through conversation
